topic: Power, Politics, and Women in the Game of Men

host_1.name: Margaret Thatcher
host_1.editor_notes: Heavy emotional tags throughout. Builds from controlled to explosive. Key moments: Geoffrey Howe betrayal (SHOUTING), weeping in the car (WHISPER, breaking), 'nation of dependents' speech (building to crescendo). Voice should crack on children/legacy material.

host_2.name: Cleopatra
host_2.editor_notes: Ranges from amused/conspiratorial to devastated (Caesarion's death) to coldly threatening ('Don't talk about my children'). Casually chilling when discussing sister's execution. Genuine awe at modern technology. Warmth emerges in final third.
